overview: Fellows receive training, a mentor and travel assistance to attend an ICANN Public Meeting. The round open in November 2026 (ICANN89 Policy Forum) is reserved for past fellows; the next round open to first-time applicants, for ICANN90 in Adelaide, is planned for 22 March to 22 April 2027.
program_dates: ICANN meetings: 13-18 March 2027 (ICANN88 Community Forum, Lisbon), 14-17 June 2027 (ICANN89 Policy Forum, Vancouver), 30 October to 4 November 2027 (ICANN90 Annual General Meeting, Adelaide)
deadline_text: ICANN90 Annual General Meeting (Adelaide, 30 Oct-4 Nov 2027): opening of the application round "22 March 2027 at 23:59 UTC", closing "22 April 2027 at 23:59 UTC", announcement "28 June 2027 at 23:59 UTC" (planned dates in the ICANN table, read 9 November 2026). The round now open is for the ICANN89 Policy Forum ("now open", deadline "5 December 2026 at 23:59 UTC"), but "First time applicants are not eligible for the ICANN Policy Forum". The ICANN88 round is closed; selected fellows are announced on 10 November 2026.
eligibility: At least 21 years of age by the time of the application submission
Interested in, or already engaged in, ICANN's work in policy building, the operation of the Domain Name System and the security and stability of the global Internet
Complete the mandatory ICANN Learn course(s)
Not involved in or associated with other ICANN-supported travel programmes at the time of selection
No more than two previous fellowships; Policy Forum applicants must have completed an ICANN Fellowship before
nationality_requirements: "Candidates from all regions and sectors are welcome to apply to the ICANN Fellowship Program." (ICANN page, read 9 November 2026)
application_process: An ICANN Account is needed to apply
Apply online during the round for a given ICANN meeting; first-time applicants can apply only to rounds for Community Forums and Annual General Meetings, not Policy Forums
Next round open to first-time applicants: ICANN90, 22 March to 22 April 2027 (planned)
potential_issues: Needs a demonstrated interest in domain names and Internet policy
The round open until 5 December 2026 is for ICANN Fellowship alumni only
The ICANN90 dates are planned dates in ICANN's table and could change
action: Complete the mandatory ICANN Learn course(s) and prepare to apply between 22 March and 22 April 2027 for ICANN90 (first-time applicants cannot apply to the round that closes on 5 December 2026).
